items.desc: President Lai Ching-te ⁠said in a National Day speech that his country is boosting defense spending to 'deter war' with China. It comes after US President Donald Trump asked Taiwan to pay for US protection.

items.title: Is China seeking to restrict Taiwan's cultural presence?
items.titleOrig: Is China seeking to restrict Taiwan's cultural presence?
items.desc: From coffee competitions to literature awards, Beijing appears to be working to limit Taiwan's international cultural and political impact.

items.desc: The Bab el-Mandeb Strait, which Yemeni government forces are trying to take back from the Houthis, is located not far from Djibouti and other African states.

items.title: Indian authorities crack down on 'Cockroach' protest in central Delhi. Follow live.
items.titleOrig: Indian authorities crack down on 'Cockroach' protest in central Delhi. Follow live.
items.desc: Indian authorities have imposed extraordinary security measures to block protesters from joining a demonstration called by the Cockroach Janta Party in New Delhi. The main leaders of the party have been detained too.

items.title: Hurricane Isaias makes landfall in Florida
items.titleOrig: Hurricane Isaias makes landfall in Florida
items.desc: US weather authorities are warning of "life-threatening" storm surges on the Gulf Coast due to the Category 2 hurricane. Extreme winds, rising water levels and possible tornadoes are also on the radar.

items.title: Mexico: Court finds three men guilty of murder of Australian, US surfers
items.titleOrig: Mexico: Court finds three men guilty of murder of Australian, US surfers
items.desc: The 2024 murders of brothers Jake and Callum Robinson, along with their friend Carter Rhoad, shocked Mexico and drew international outrage.

items.title: Trump weighs livestream execution amid bipartisan backlash
items.titleOrig: Trump weighs livestream execution amid bipartisan backlash
items.desc: Donald Trump said he hasn't decided whether the execution of the Fort Hood shooter will be livestreamed, after the Pentagon announced it would do so. The plan has been criticized by both Republicans and Democrats.

items.title: Trump names new press secretary to succeed Karoline Leavitt
items.titleOrig: Trump names new press secretary to succeed Karoline Leavitt
items.desc: Trump has appointed Katie Zacharia to take over the White House press secretary role vacated by Karoline Leavitt. She assumes the role with Trump struggling with low approval ratings driven by the US war with Iran.

items.title: Schools crisis in France: Investment fails to inspire confidence
items.titleOrig: Schools crisis in France: Investment fails to inspire confidence
items.desc: For weeks, schoolchildren in France have been protesting the failing education system. Compared to many other countries, France invests heavily in education but critics say that the funds are not distributed fairly.

items.title: Trump, Putin agree on deal to release Russian diesel to US, world markets
items.titleOrig: Trump, Putin agree on deal to release Russian diesel to US, world markets
items.desc: Russia will supply diesel to global markets in a bid to lower prices, US President Donald Trump has said. The move reverses years of pressure on the Russian economy following the invasion of Ukraine.

items.title: Strong earthquakes shake Panama, buildings damaged
items.titleOrig: Strong earthquakes shake Panama, buildings damaged
items.desc: Panama's president has declared a "major disaster" after a series of tremors damaged buildings, briefly suspended flights and triggered a tsunami alert in Central and South America.
